import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router that evaluates rules in order and sends rows to the first matching port.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port "standard" (which is not output here).
    """
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize output buckets
    fast_track = []
    high_value = []
    manual_review = []
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1 → fast_track
    rule1_mask = (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1)
    rule1_rows = rule1_mask & ~matched
    fast_track.append(claims[rule1_rows])
    matched = matched | rule1_rows
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000 → high_value
    rule2_mask = claims["amount"] > 10000
    rule2_rows = rule2_mask & ~matched
    high_value.append(claims[rule2_rows])
    matched = matched | rule2_rows
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500 → manual_review
    rule3_mask = (claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500)
    rule3_rows = rule3_mask & ~matched
    manual_review.append(claims[rule3_rows])
    matched = matched | rule3_rows
    
    # Unmatched rows go to default port "standard" (not output)
    
    # Concatenate results, selecting only the required columns
    output_columns = ["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]
    
    claims_fast_track = pd.concat(fast_track, ignore_index=False)[output_columns] if fast_track and fast_track[0].shape[0] > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    claims_high_value = pd.concat(high_value, ignore_index=False)[output_columns] if high_value and high_value[0].shape[0] > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    claims_manual_review = pd.concat(manual_review, ignore_index=False)[output_columns] if manual_review and manual_review[0].shape[0] > 0 else pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    
    # Ensure proper handling of empty dataframes
    if claims_fast_track.empty:
        claims_fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    if claims_high_value.empty:
        claims_high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    if claims_manual_review.empty:
        claims_manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=output_columns)
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": claims_fast_track,
        "claims_high_value": claims_high_value,
        "claims_manual_review": claims_manual_review
    }
